question: Is the Gazebo vs fake-bridge gap for student_L1_best.npz an artefact of FakeBridge ignoring --seed?
prediction: With spawn-paired seeds the fake-bridge and Gazebo arms differ by at most 1 success in 20 episodes.
falsifier: gap <= 1 success in 20 supports H-0007; gap >= 2 falsifies it
safety: S0 sim only; no Pi, ssh, deploy, car, wheels or motor; no GPU; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty

commands.fake: uv run python simulation/gazebo/run_policy_episodes.py --bridge fake --episodes 20 --seed 11 --level L1 --weights rl/runs/gazebo_l6/student_L1_best.npz --json rl/runs/gazebo_l6/student_L1_best_fake_20ep_s11_20261117.json
commands.note: Both run files already existed when this write-up was made; no simulation was run here.

seeding_check.FakeBridge.reset: line 113: rng = random.Random(self.seed * 1000003 + episode); line 114-115 draw d, b and yaw from it. seed=0 reproduces legacy random.Random(episode).

fake.sensing: none: policy receives ground-truth pose, dt and valid=True (run_policy_episodes.py:416; no sensor_observation on FakeBridge, see :342)

gap_note: gazebo minus fake = 6 successes in 20 episodes (raw gap, no adjustment)

old_result.note: Predates FakeBridge honouring --seed. Only 10 episodes per arm.

spawn_caveat.FakeBridge: d in [0.5,1.5] uniform; bearing uniform in +/-0.5 rad (~28.6 deg); yaw uniform in +/-1.0 rad (~57.3 deg); via random.Random
spawn_caveat.Gazebo: LEVELS['L1'] in simulation/gazebo/lockstep_env.py:51-: dist (0.5,1.5); bearing +/-30 deg; yaw +/-60 deg; via np.random.default_rng([seed, episode])
spawn_caveat.effect: Same seed and episode index do not give the same start pose. Spawn ranges are close but not equal, and the draws use different generators.

confounds.name: sensing
confounds.detail: FakeBridge arm gets ground-truth pose with no sensor noise, latency or tag dropouts (run_policy_episodes.py:416). Gazebo arm uses emulated sensing with LEVELS['L1'] noise=1.0 and latency 0.08 s (lockstep_env.py L1). The fake arm is therefore not the same sensing condition.

confounds.name: plant
confounds.detail: FakeBridge is a kinematic point mass with synthetic yaw coupling (run_policy_episodes.py:105); Gazebo is lockstep Gazebo Harmonic dynamics. The gap mixes plant with sensing and spawn differences.

confounds.name: controller_label_and_shield
confounds.detail: Labels differ (student vs student-shield-none) only because ctrl is set from is_gz (run_policy_episodes.py:535). Both arms take the same --student-shield default 'none' (:458-462, :527-528), so both ran shield=False. This is verified from the code path only; the run JSONs do not record the shield setting.

confounds.name: determinism
confounds.detail: No bitwise reproducibility claim. The H-0006 notes record matched-config runs that differ (2803 vs 2616 frames). One 20-episode run per arm, so the counts carry sampling noise.

determinism_note: One run per arm. No bitwise reproducibility claim is made.
verdict: FALSIFIED as stated. Raw gap = 6 successes in 20 episodes (Gazebo 6/20 vs fake 0/20), which is >= 2. Confound, stated next to the gap: the arms differ in sensing (fake arm has ground-truth pose, Gazebo arm has emulated L1 noise and latency), in plant (kinematic point mass vs Gazebo), and in spawn distribution. The gap therefore cannot be attributed to the FakeBridge seeding fix alone, and it cannot be attributed to the plant alone.
shield: Both arms used shield=False by the same default. The controller labels differ only by naming (run_policy_episodes.py:535). No shield mismatch was found.
